scope: Design-only contract for a future project-owned UE command echo receiver shell. No runtime receiver, UE GUI, Unreal build, source edit, Blueprint/UMG/asset edit, MWORKS/ROS2/UE runtime call, or UI accepted-state enablement occurred.

component_boundary: Project-owned UE Bridge component or narrow adapter.
No direct Actor transform, teleport, keyboard, or mouse pose-control surface.

forbidden_inputs_as_ack: UE global truth map or sensor oracle rows

sink_contract.pending_precondition: A matching command request must have been recorded by RecordPendingCommandFromPacketJson.
match_guards: ack_authority present and consistent with source

rejection_or_non_runtime_rules.case: source is quadrotor.unreal_state frame receiver or UDP send result
rejection_or_non_runtime_rules.result: not a command echo; do not call ApplyCommandEchoJson as runtime ack

rejection_or_non_runtime_rules.case: orphan echo without matching pending command request
rejection_or_non_runtime_rules.result: reject or record disabled invalid state; no runtime acceptance

rejection_or_non_runtime_rules.case: stale, duplicate, malformed, seq mismatch, command kind mismatch, authority mismatch, missing timestamp, missing status, or no_pose_overwrite_status!=pass
rejection_or_non_runtime_rules.result: reject or keep disabled invalid state; no runtime acceptance

allowed_future_scope: future C++ shell source only if separately dispatched
must_check: new receiver component exists with command echo role
new receiver component accepts mosim.ue_command_echo.v1 only
new receiver component calls ApplyCommandEchoJson as the only state sink
new receiver component does not parse quadrotor.unreal_state.* as command ack
new receiver component does not use UDP send success as command ack
new receiver component does not mix with UQuadrotorMworksUdpReceiverComponent frame/status receiver
new receiver component does not mix with UQuadrotorMworksUdpCommandSenderComponent sender-only path
new receiver component has no Actor transform, teleport, input binding, keyboard, or mouse pose-control APIs
non-live source labels remain smoke_only and accepted_as_runtime_ack=false
authoritative source/ack_authority/status/timestamp/command-id/no_pose_overwrite_status gates are present before accepted runtime state

gate_decisions.runtime_receiver_implementation_reason: MWORKS/ROS2 live command-echo transport provenance remains unavailable; existing receiver-boundary checker still reports current_live_echo_receiver_present=false and safe_to_implement_runtime_receiver_next=false.
gate_decisions.compile_gate_reason: 010 did not edit UE source and PMO explicitly forbids Unreal build in this task.
gate_decisions.ui_binding_next: static-only UI binding contract preflight may be a later task, but accepted-state UI controls must remain disabled until authoritative live echo transport exists.

claim_boundary: 010 is source-static receiver shell contract design only.
010 does not implement or validate a live UE runtime receiver.
010 does not prove live MWORKS downlink or ROS2 runtime acknowledgement.
010 does not bind or enable Blueprint/UMG/Slate accepted-state controls.
010 does not prove planner_ready, closed_loop, controller performance, FAST-LIO success, localization/local-map quality, mission success, or final UI acceptance.
